create_gif_builder: create a GIFBuilder instance with custom width, height, and fps for building animated GIFs
add_frames_to_gif: add numpy array or PIL Image frames to the GIFBuilder using add_frame or add_frames
optimize_gif_colors: optimize GIF frame colors using global palette quantization with a target number of colors
deduplicate_gif_frames: remove near-duplicate consecutive frames from the GIFBuilder to reduce file size
save_optimized_gif: save the GIFBuilder frames as an optimized GIF with optional emoji sizing and duplicate removal
